bio.en:
Teresa Soo is the co-founder of Shugaosha and the Australian Representative of the Japan Small Face Correction Certification Association. After completing her advanced training in Japan, she became a certified trainer and went on to develop The Shugaosha Way—a gentle hands-on approach that helps restore natural facial balance for a more lifted, firmer, youthful and harmonious appearance.

With years of hands-on experience and a commitment to continuous education, Teresa has treated over 2,000 faces, while mentoring the next generation of practitioners.
bio.zh:
Teresa 是 Shugaosha 修顏社聯合創辦人，同時擔任日本小顏矯正認定協會澳洲代表。完成日本進階培訓後，她成為認證導師，並創立了「修顏社小顏術（The Shugaosha Way）」，以溫和徒手方式協助恢復自然面部平衡，塑造更提升、更緊緻、更年輕、更和諧的面容。

憑藉多年實踐經驗及持續深造，Teresa 已完成超過 2,000 張面孔的療程，同時培育新一代小顏矯正專業人才。

role.zh: 聯合創辦人｜認證小顏矯正師

bio.en:
Charles Cho is the co-founder of Shugaosha and a certified specialist of the Japan Small Face Correction Certification Association. Known for his calm and meticulous approach, he tailors every treatment to each individual’s facial structure, helping clients achieve a more balanced, youthful, lifted and harmonious appearance.

With years of hands-on experience, Charles has treated over 1,000 faces while continuing to refine The Shugaosha Way.
bio.zh:
Charles 是 Shugaosha 修顏社聯合創辦人，同時為日本小顏矯正認定協會認證小顏矯正師。他以溫和、細緻及講求平衡的徒手手法見稱，按照每位客人的面部結構制定適合的調整方式，協助塑造更平衡、更年輕、更提升、更和諧的面部輪廓。

憑藉多年實踐經驗，Charles 已完成超過 1,000 張面孔的療程，並持續完善及精進「修顏社小顏術（The Shugaosha Way）」。
